defect_summary: Ship pull request #71 was offered while GitHub still allowed squash onto main.
unsuitable_process: CREATE_PR and the offer body do not lock merge-commit-only. The repo allows squash, merge, and rebase. ADR 0044 requires the tag on a merge commit, but that is not a GitHub merge-method constraint.
climb_steps: PR #71 body mentioned tagging a merge commit but did not lock the method.
allow_squash_merge is true on the hub repo.
CREATE_PR calls gh pr create directly, not pr-offer-gate.py.
ADR 0044 tag-on-merge-commit is policy without a merge-method gate.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
